# remediations

Opinionated cluster remediations applied as policy

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  remediations:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Under `stack.remediations.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `allowedRegistriesForImport` | Registries permitted for `oc import-image` | 2 entries, below |
| `allowedRegistries` | Registries the cluster may pull from at runtime | 3 entries, below |

<details><summary><code>allowedRegistriesForImport</code> default</summary>

```yaml
- domainName: quay.io
  insecure: false
- domainName: registry.redhat.io
  insecure: false
```

</details>

<details><summary><code>allowedRegistries</code> default</summary>

```yaml
- quay.io
- registry.redhat.io
- image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000
```

</details>

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration, SI-7 Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity. Categories: CM Configuration Management, SI System and Information Integrity.

### Policy `registries`

`registries-remediations-<cluster>`: Restrict image registries the cluster may use.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `registries-allowlist` | enforce | high | [allowlist](converters/registries/allowlist.yaml) | Image registry allowlist |

### Policy `samples`

`samples-remediations-<cluster>`: Remove the Samples Operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `samples-operator` | enforce | low | [operator](converters/samples/operator.yaml) | Samples Operator management state |
